question: Are the videos free?
answer: Yes. Every lesson on our YouTube channel is free to watch. We earn through optional paid test series and future batches — the teaching itself stays free.

question: Is the live exam really free?
answer: Completely free for v1. Register with your email, show up on Sunday at 11 AM IST, attempt the paper, and get your score plus All-India rank. No hidden paywall after registration.

question: How does the All-India merit list work?
answer: Everyone starts at the same second. When the exam window closes, we grade all attempts, rank by score (ties broken by earlier submission), and publish the merit list within about 60 minutes. Top 10% get a downloadable certificate.

question: What happens if my internet drops mid-exam?
answer: Your answers autosave every few seconds. Reconnect and re-enter the attempt page — you'll pick up where you left off until the timer ends. If you can't reconnect before time's up, whatever was saved gets graded.

question: Can I attempt on mobile?
answer: Yes. The exam UI is built mobile-first. Use Chrome or Safari, keep the tab in focus, and allow fullscreen when prompted. Budget Android phones work — we've tested on 360px widths.

question: Is it CBSE only?
answer: No. School maths covers CBSE, Gujarat Board, and state boards. Competitive tracks cover IBPS, SBI, SSC CGL, CHSL, Railways, and general aptitude.

question: Do you cover Gujarat Board?
answer: Yes — we're based in Ahmedabad and many of our school students are Gujarat Board. The methods work across boards; we call out board-specific quirks where they matter.

question: What about SSC CGL 2026 pattern?
answer: We track official notifications and update mock papers when the commission confirms changes. Current mocks follow the latest known quant pattern with last-five-years topic weighting.

question: Do you have a Telegram group?
answer: A Telegram channel for daily questions and exam reminders is on the roadmap. For now, subscribe on YouTube and join our WhatsApp channel (link on the contact page) for updates.

question: Are notes in English or Hindi?
answer: PDFs and the site UI are in English with Hinglish-friendly explanations in videos. Hindi/Hinglish UI toggle is planned for a later phase.

question: Can I get personal doubt solving?
answer: Free videos and live exams don't include 1:1 doubt calls. Comment on YouTube or WhatsApp us — we reply to common doubts in upcoming videos. Paid batches (future) will include structured doubt sessions.

question: What if I switch tabs during the live exam?
answer: You'll get a warning. Three violations (tab switch, exiting fullscreen, paste attempts) trigger an auto-submit. Your saved answers are still graded — you just can't keep attempting after that.
